title: engines.json
description: Engine plugin manifest read by load_engine_manifest (src/agent/engines/engine_registry.cpp) and by the CLI (apps/cli/src/cli_core.cpp). Unknown keys are ignored by both parsers. load_engine_manifest treats a non-string "name" or "isolation" as absent.

path.description: Plugin file. A relative path resolves against the directory of engines.json.

name.description: Engine name. If missing or empty, derived from agent-engine-<name>.<ext>.

isolation.description: Overrides the Default of Config::engine_isolation for this engine.
